C-HOSTED-VALIDATION-RECOVERY.ApprovalBasis: Bounded repair of two observed required-CI failures under standing stabilization integration authorization.
C-HOSTED-VALIDATION-RECOVERY.IntentSummary: Guard Find-query prefill to noncollapsed same-block selections while retaining menu updates. Rewrite the single stalled Azure HTTP Ubuntu URI to canonical HTTPS in hosted CI sources, retaining all existing apt guards. Verify without editing navigation oracles.

MustContain.Text: collapsed selection preserves an active Find query

MustPassCommand.Command: env CI=1 npx --no-install playwright test tests/e2e/table- tests/e2e/block-viewer.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-tables --project=webkit-block-viewer

T-001.Title: Preserve Find state on caret updates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Collapsed selection does not replace query/matches or change document bytes/saved state; native menu synchronization still fires; nonempty selection still prefills Find. Existing navigation checks remain exact.

T-002.Title: Use canonical HTTPS Ubuntu sources in hosted CI

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Only matching Azure HTTP Ubuntu URIs change in existing source files. Signed repository metadata, package list and apt time/retry guards remain unchanged. Fresh hosted checks pass.
